notes: I did not run the Next app: the shared-tree rules forbid next dev/build/start. Checks that did run: whole-tree tsc clean at finish; eslint clean on my files; npm run check OK (71 warnings, none from my files); node --check passes on the probe and the bake script. The DOM logic of both games ran in a static Playwright harness (scratchpad/w3g: transpiled run.ts and flight.ts with stubbed libs). The React shells (DroneBand, DroneGame, DeadEyeCall, DeadEyeHud) are typechecked and linted but were not rendered in a browser.

Cross-builder dependency: capabilities.tsx passes `star={{ id: "B27", weight: 2 }}` to BlueprintSchematic. That prop comes from W3-IDIOTS's uncommitted change to schematic.tsx. If their change does not land, remove that one prop.

The egg runtime no longer shows the Dead Eye toast (Q-RD-2 + deadeye.status); the HUD shows the score instead. The typed 'deadeye' and the palette reach the game through components/eggs/dead-eye.ts, which sends the DEAD_EYE_CALL event.

Content: no new strings. All copy comes from the existing toy.drone.* / toy.deadeye.* keys, resolved on the server. Gate lines use the gauntlet titles verbatim. Rows, verdicts, reasons and links are untouched. Computed AA on the graded ground: fg-muted ≈ 8.6:1, ghost ≈ 5.6:1. The frozen-frontier plate shows only in the outer 6% at 0.2 opacity.

The drone sprites are our own ChalkQuadcopter drawing, baked by Chromium's chalk filter into assets/p3/games/*.png (2 KB each). The bake script sits beside them. IC-3I-08 holds: no window, feed, song, crash or label, and nothing names Rancho.
